title: pleurothallis cylindrica
intro: Pleurothallis cylindrica, commonly known as the cylindrical pleurothallis, is a species of orchid native to Central and South America. This epiphytic orchid is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce swelling, prevent infection, and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of Pleurothallis cylindrica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
